stops.title: Firi ɔhɔhoɔ kɔsi ɔmanfoɔ
stops.caption: Ɛtwa ɛnan, nhwɛmu baako.
stops.speech: Obiara wɔ kwan korɔ no ara so baabi: ɔhɔhoɔ, ɔsanba, na ɔmanfoɔ sɛ nnawɔtwe nnan adesua no wie a.

stops.title: Baabi a gyinabea pue
stops.caption: Wɔ nsensaneɛ so, ne nsɛm no mu.
stops.speech: Nhwɛmu nsensaneɛ no kyerɛ gyinaberɛ a obi wɔ, enti wohunu ntɛm sɛ hwan na obiara nnii n’akyi da.
